note: San Bernardino NF campground in an open pine flat beside the Big Pine Flat fire station, about 7 mi up the graded dirt Forest Road 3N14 from Fawnskin; on-site host, nearest showers at Serrano. OHV roads and the Redonda Ridge OHV trail start nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page read: $29 ($30 holiday, +$8 extra vehicle, 8-person cap), 19 FCFS sites, 30-ft spurs, host; seasonal (2025 season Apr 19-Oct 5, now 'Site Closed'); not on rec.gov. Page contradicts itself on drinking water (cleared to unknown) and restrooms. OHV-area flag for the reviewer. Phone and website filled.
flags: OHV (reviewer decides, not dropped): the FS page lists 'OHV Trail Riding, OHV Road Riding, OHV Camping' and 'Redonda Ridge OHV Trail 1W17' as nearby, and its restrictions require a spark arrester 'whenever you are operating your OHV'. It is billed as a 'Family Campground' (19 sites, host, water), not a staging area or trailhead, so it reads as a general campground with OHV use nearby - but check.

FACILITIES: the FS page contradicts itself on water ('Campsites include ... drinking water' and 'availability of water is limited' vs 'Potable water is not available at this site') - stored derived false cleared to unknown. It also says 'Restrooms are not available at this site', against the stored derived vault_toilets true; left unchanged (the amenity block looks like a template default beside a host-staffed campground) but worth a look.
